meaning:
Month of exodus and passover (March or April)
Also named: ni.san (נִיסָן "Nisan" H5212)
This name means fresh, young barley ears, barley

elsewhere.note: The flax and the barley were struck, for the barley had ripened and the flax was blooming.
“ ‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to Yahweh, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire…
Observe the month of Abib, and keep the Passover to Yahweh your God; for in the month of Abib Yahweh your God brought you out of Egypt by night.
